name: Machine Polishing & Paint Correction
tagline: Removes 70–80% of the swirls cheap car washes put there.
intro: Swirl marks and light scratches are what make dark paint look dull and grey in daylight. A two-step machine polish cuts them out and refines the finish back to a sharp, deep gloss.
forWho: Dull, scratched or weathered paintwork — especially black, grey and dark blue cars that have been through automated washes.
includes: Everything in the Premium Exterior Detail first
Paint depth assessed before any correction begins
Cutting stage — heavy, medium or light compound depending on clear-coat damage
Removes light scratches, oxidation, swirl marks and general dullness
Refining micro-cut polish to restore depth, clarity and high gloss
70–80% of swirl marks and light scratches removed
Only microns of clear coat removed, never millimetres — the paint stays healthy
Protection applied to lock the finish in
note: Recommended about once a year to maintain paint integrity, and normally carried out before a ceramic coating goes on.
metaDescription: Two-step machine polishing removes 70-80% of swirl marks and light scratches. Mobile paint correction across Kent, from £250.

name: SMART Repair & Removals
tagline: Scratches, kerbed alloys, badges and old signage.
intro: Small, medium and repeatable repairs done properly — without the cost or the week off the road that a body shop involves. I'm honest about what SMART repair can and can't do.
forWho: Kerbed wheels, small scratches through the clear coat, de-badging, and removing old business signage before sale.

items.name: Exterior SMART scratch / defect repair
items.body: For small scratches that have gone through the clear coat to the base coat, metal or primer. Book at least a week ahead — the paint has to be colour-matched and ordered. Where filler is involved it takes two sessions because of curing times. Includes an exterior detail. I am not a body shop and I'll tell you when something needs one.

items.name: SMART alloy repair
items.body: Sanding, filler and re-spray. This does not cover diamond-cut or powder-coated finishes — a body shop typically charges around £400 a wheel for those. I'd recommend having the wheels rebalanced afterwards, usually £8–£15 a wheel at a garage.

items.name: Badge removal
items.body: De-badged and then machine polished so there's no outline, adhesive or ghosting left where the badge used to sit.

items.name: Vinyl / sticker removal
items.body: Removing printed signage and vinyl from vehicles. Priced on how much there is to come off. For the best result book it alongside an exterior detail — do that and you get 25% off the detail.

metaDescription: Kerbed alloys, small scratches, de-badging and old signage removed. Honest advice on what SMART repair can and can't fix. Kent, from £100.
